recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no core follow-up is needed unless ValueSet.scope is restored or the work group reconsiders markdown for include.copyright.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive Vocab issue asking to change ValueSet.compose.include.copyright, ValueSet.scope.inclusionCriteria, and ValueSet.scope.exclusionCriteria from string to markdown because they may contain more than one paragraph of text.
initial_application: Commit 39f96b21ce8d65b5b086b3ee61a455e47a359a98 explicitly mentioned FHIR-39595 and changed all three named ValueSet elements from string to markdown in source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-28297 originally introduced include.copyright as string. Current source and build.fhir.org show include.copyright as markdown. A later R6-preparation commit, 40306e5cd9c1b1e3eb6f115de16a8da3aa13a351, removed ValueSet.scope and its subelements, so scope.inclusionCriteria and scope.exclusionCriteria no longer need datatype reconciliation in the current build.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The still-current FHIR-39595 element is markdown, and source search found no current ValueSet.scope criteria elements.

related_jiras.note: Originally added ValueSet.compose.include.copyright as a 0..1 string element for R5.
Referenced by FHIR-39595 as the reason to review these datatypes, but not needed for the bounded current-source decision.
